paper.title: Class 12 English (अंग्रेज़ी - 100 Marks) 2026 Set G (Bihar Board (BSEB))

questions.text: Choose a one-word substitution 'Ceremony of crowning a king':
questions.textHindi: Choose a one-word substitution 'Ceremony of crowning a king':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Coronation
The act or ceremony of crowning a monarch is known as a coronation.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - "Blow one's own trumpet" :
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - "Blow one's own trumpet" :
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) To praise oneself
The idiom "to blow one's own trumpet" means to boast or talk proudly about one's own achievements.

questions.text: The two friends had a ________ talk after a long time.
questions.textHindi: The two friends had a ________ talk after a long time.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) heart to heart
A "heart-to-heart" talk refers to a candid, intimate, and deeply personal conversation between friends.

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of 'Humility':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct antonym of 'Humility':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Pride
"Humility" signifies modesty and lowliness, which is the exact opposite of "pride" (arrogance).

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'Relish':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct synonym of 'Relish':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Enjoy
To "relish" something means to enjoy or appreciate it thoroughly.

questions.text: Choose the correct antonym of 'Scorn':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct antonym of 'Scorn':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Admiration
"Scorn" denotes disrespect or contempt, making "admiration" (deep respect or approval) its antonym.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - "To keep one's temper":
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - "To keep one's temper":
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) To remain calm
"To keep one's temper" means to refrain from getting angry and maintain composure.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - "To cry wolf":
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - "To cry wolf":
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) To give a false alarm
The idiom "to cry wolf" comes from Aesop's fable and means to raise a false alarm repeatedly when there is no real danger.

questions.text: They decided to ________ his number in the yellow pages.
questions.textHindi: They decided to ________ his number in the yellow pages.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) look up
The phrasal verb "to look up" means to search for specific information or a contact in a directory/book.

questions.text: After a prolonged suffering he 'passed away'.
questions.textHindi: After a prolonged suffering he 'passed away'.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) expired
"Passed away" is a polite euphemism meaning died or expired.

questions.text: We have no alternative plan to ________ on.
questions.textHindi: We have no alternative plan to ________ on.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) fall back
The phrasal verb "to fall back on" means to resort to a backup plan or reserve support in an emergency.

questions.text: She came across some papers she was looking for.
questions.textHindi: She came across some papers she was looking for.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) found unexpectedly
"To come across" means to find, meet, or discover something or someone by chance.

questions.text: She needs some new clothes, ________?
questions.textHindi: She needs some new clothes, ________?
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) doesn't she
"Needs" is present simple third-person affirmative, requiring the negative question tag auxiliary "doesn't she".

questions.text: The synonym of 'Marvellous' is ________
questions.textHindi: The synonym of 'Marvellous' is ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) Wonderful
"Marvellous" means extraordinarily good or astounding, which is synonymous with "wonderful".

questions.text: The antonym of 'Fixed' is ________
questions.textHindi: The antonym of 'Fixed' is ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Undecided
A matter or date that is "fixed" is settled; its direct opposite among the given choices is "undecided".

questions.text: The synonym of 'Hoard' is ________
questions.textHindi: The synonym of 'Hoard' is ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Store
To "hoard" means to amass, accumulate, or secretly store away items for future use.

questions.text: The antonym of 'Moisture' is ________
questions.textHindi: The antonym of 'Moisture' is ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Dryness
"Moisture" denotes dampness or wetness, making "dryness" its exact opposite.

questions.text: Sumit asked her if she was ill. (Choose the correct direct narration)
questions.textHindi: Sumit asked her if she was ill. (Choose the correct direct narration)

options.text: Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"
options.textHindi: Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"

options.text: Sumit said to her, "Is she ill ?"
options.textHindi: Sumit said to her, "Is she ill ?"

questions.correctAnswerText: (C) Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Sumit said to her, "Are you ill ?"
The reported clause "if she was ill" transforms back to direct speech second person inverted present: "Are you ill?".

questions.text: It is impossible to do this. (Choose the correct passive voice)
questions.textHindi: It is impossible to do this. (Choose the correct passive voice)

options.text: This is impossible to be done
options.textHindi: This is impossible to be done

options.text: To do this by it is impossible
options.textHindi: To do this by it is impossible

options.text: It is impossible to have done this
options.textHindi: It is impossible to have done this

questions.correctAnswerText: (A) This is impossible to be done
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) This is impossible to be done
Transforming "to do this" into passive yields "this is impossible to be done".

questions.text: "Call the witness," said the judge. (Choose the correct indirect speech)
questions.textHindi: "Call the witness," said the judge. (Choose the correct indirect speech)

options.text: The judge commanded to call the witness
options.textHindi: The judge commanded to call the witness

options.text: The judge commanded them to call the witness
options.textHindi: The judge commanded them to call the witness

options.text: The judge commanded that the witness be called
options.textHindi: The judge commanded that the witness be called

options.text: The judge commanded the witness to be called
options.textHindi: The judge commanded the witness to be called

questions.correctAnswerText: (B) The judge commanded them to call the witness
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) The judge commanded them to call the witness
Imperative indirect commands take an object followed by the infinitive ("commanded them to call...").

questions.text: The doctor advised him to rest for ________ days.
questions.textHindi: The doctor advised him to rest for ________ days.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) a few
Countable plural days with a positive sense requires "a few".

questions.text: A thorough search of the aircraft was carried ________ in the airport.
questions.textHindi: A thorough search of the aircraft was carried ________ in the airport.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) out
"Carry out" means to execute or conduct an operation, test, or search.

questions.text: As she became tired, error began to creep ________ her work.
questions.textHindi: As she became tired, error began to creep ________ her work.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) into
The phrasal verb "creep into" means to slowly infiltrate or start occurring in something.

questions.text: Choose a one-word substitution for 'The absence of government in a country':
questions.textHindi: Choose a one-word substitution for 'The absence of government in a country':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Anarchy
Anarchy is the state of disorder due to absence or non-recognition of authority or governing systems.

questions.text: He requested me to keep the door open. (Choose the correct direct narration)
questions.textHindi: He requested me to keep the door open. (Choose the correct direct narration)

options.text: He said to me, "Please keep the door open."
options.textHindi: He said to me, "Please keep the door open."

options.text: He will say, "Keep the door open."
options.textHindi: He will say, "Keep the door open."

options.text: He said, "Never keep the door open."
options.textHindi: He said, "Never keep the door open."

questions.correctAnswerText: (A) He said to me, "Please keep the door open."
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) He said to me, "Please keep the door open."
The reporting verb "requested" in direct speech is represented by the polite marker "Please" in the imperative.

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.textHindi: Choose the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Jaundice
The accurate medical spelling is J-A-U-N-D-I-C-E.

questions.text: India will win the world cup. That is certain. (Choose the correct combination)
questions.textHindi: India will win the world cup. That is certain. (Choose the correct combination)

options.text: It is certain that India will win the world cup
options.textHindi: It is certain that India will win the world cup

options.text: India will certainly win the world cup
options.textHindi: India will certainly win the world cup

options.text: Certainly, India will win the world cup
options.textHindi: Certainly, India will win the world cup

options.text: India will win the world cup certainly
options.textHindi: India will win the world cup certainly

questions.correctAnswerText: (A) It is certain that India will win the world cup
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) It is certain that India will win the world cup
Combining two clauses with an anticipatory "It is certain that..." preserves the precise grammar and meaning of the original sentences.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence:
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct sentence:

options.text: The boys runs fast in the race
options.textHindi: The boys runs fast in the race

options.text: The boys run fast in the race
options.textHindi: The boys run fast in the race

options.text: The boy run fast in the race
options.textHindi: The boy run fast in the race

options.text: The boy running fast in the race
options.textHindi: The boy running fast in the race

questions.correctAnswerText: (B) The boys run fast in the race
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) The boys run fast in the race
Plural subject "The boys" correctly takes the base plural verb "run".

questions.text: I got late for the flight ________ there was so much traffic on the roa
questions.textHindi: I got late for the flight ________ there was so much traffic on the roa
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) because
"Because" introduces the clause providing the explicit cause or reason for being late.

questions.text: We located the key ________ the lock.
questions.textHindi: We located the key ________ the lock.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) for
The preposition "for" establishes purpose/possession pointing to the intended matching item (a key for the lock).

questions.text: Sunaina loves ________ to musi
questions.textHindi: Sunaina loves ________ to musi
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) listening
Verbs of preference like "love" commonly take the gerund form ("listening") to describe enjoying an activity.

questions.text: There ________ an armchair in my bedroom.
questions.textHindi: There ________ an armchair in my bedroom.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) is
The singular subject "an armchair" takes the singular verb "is".

questions.text: The boys ________ very tired today because they were at a party last night.
questions.textHindi: The boys ________ very tired today because they were at a party last night.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) are
The time marker "today" denotes the present state of the plural subject "The boys", requiring "are".

questions.text: Rohini said, "I have a stomach-ache."
questions.textHindi: Rohini said, "I have a stomach-ache."

options.text: Rohini says that she have a stomach-ache.
options.textHindi: Rohini says that she have a stomach-ache.

options.text: Rohini said that she had got a stomach-ache.
options.textHindi: Rohini said that she had got a stomach-ache.

options.text: Rohini said that she has a stomach-ache.
options.textHindi: Rohini said that she has a stomach-ache.

options.text: Rohini said that she had a stomach-ache.
options.textHindi: Rohini said that she had a stomach-ache.

questions.correctAnswerText: (D) Rohini said that she had a stomach-ache.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Rohini said that she had a stomach-ache.
Backshifting the present tense "have" to past tense gives "had" in reported speech (noted with typographical variance in original options).

questions.text: The meeting ________ at half-past eight.
questions.textHindi: The meeting ________ at half-past eight.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) starts
Simple present tense ("starts") is standard for scheduled events or timetabled occurrences in the future.

questions.text: Choose the correct meaning of - 'Docile':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct meaning of - 'Docile':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Obedient
"Docile" means submissive, easily managed, or obedient.

questions.text: Ankita ________ come yet; the whole class is waiting for her.
questions.textHindi: Ankita ________ come yet; the whole class is waiting for her.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) hasn't
The adverb "yet" used with a singular subject ("Ankita") requires present perfect negative ("hasn't").

questions.text: Let us organise a get-together party. (Choose the correct passive voice)
questions.textHindi: Let us organise a get-together party. (Choose the correct passive voice)

options.text: We should be organising a get-together party
options.textHindi: We should be organising a get-together party

options.text: Get-together party must be surely organised
options.textHindi: Get-together party must be surely organised

options.text: A get-together party should be organised
options.textHindi: A get-together party should be organised

options.text: A get-together party would be organised by us.
options.textHindi: A get-together party would be organised by us.

questions.correctAnswerText: (C) A get-together party should be organised
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) A get-together party should be organised
Suggestions starting with "Let us" change into passive via "Subject + should be + V3".

questions.text: Milan is ________ Italian city.
questions.textHindi: Milan is ________ Italian city.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) an
"Italian" begins with a vowel sound, requiring the indefinite article "an".

questions.text: Rolls-Royce cars are ________
questions.textHindi: Rolls-Royce cars are ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) expensive
Semantically and contextually, luxury Rolls-Royce vehicles are characterized as expensive.

questions.text: ________ languages does Aryan speak ?
questions.textHindi: ________ languages does Aryan speak ?
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) How many
"Languages" is a countable plural noun, which takes the quantifier "How many".

questions.text: That's my book. Can I have ________ back please?
questions.textHindi: That's my book. Can I have ________ back please?
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) it
The singular pronoun "it" substitutes for the singular non-living noun "book".

questions.text: Choose the correct synonym of 'Jealous':
questions.textHindi: Choose the correct synonym of 'Jealous':
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Envious
"Jealous" and "envious" are direct synonyms expressing covetous resentment towards others' fortunes.

questions.text: The ________ duty of every citizen is to respect the country.
questions.textHindi: The ________ duty of every citizen is to respect the country.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) first and foremost
"First and foremost" is an idiomatic collocation meaning most important or primary.

questions.text: Make sure you ________ at least two hours before your flight.
questions.textHindi: Make sure you ________ at least two hours before your flight.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) check in
"Check in" is the official aviation term for registering one's arrival for an airline flight.

questions.text: Sheetal ran fast. She wanted to win the race. (Choose the correct combination)
questions.textHindi: Sheetal ran fast. She wanted to win the race. (Choose the correct combination)

options.text: Sheetal running fast for winning the race
options.textHindi: Sheetal running fast for winning the race

options.text: Sheetal is running fast to win the race
options.textHindi: Sheetal is running fast to win the race

options.text: Running fast is Sheetal for winning the race
options.textHindi: Running fast is Sheetal for winning the race

options.text: Sheetal ran fast to win the race
options.textHindi: Sheetal ran fast to win the race

questions.correctAnswerText: (D) Sheetal ran fast to win the race
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Sheetal ran fast to win the race
Using the infinitive of purpose ("to win") cleanly connects the two past actions.

questions.text: He broke the lock ________ a hammer.
questions.textHindi: He broke the lock ________ a hammer.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) with the help of
The prepositional phrase "with the help of" denotes using an instrument or tool.

questions.text: Abriti has decided ________ more.
questions.textHindi: Abriti has decided ________ more.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) to earn
The verb "decided" takes an infinitive verb phrase ("to earn") after it.

questions.text: ________ have that dress specially made ?
questions.textHindi: ________ have that dress specially made ?
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Could you
"Could you" properly forms a modal polite question directly followed by the base causative structure "have that dress specially made".

questions.text: Learning ________ is not easy.
questions.textHindi: Learning ________ is not easy.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Sanskrit
Names of academic subjects or languages do not take articles or redundant prepositions when used as direct objects.

questions.text: I saw two crows ________ poking their heads at the flowerpot.
questions.textHindi: I saw two crows ________ poking their heads at the flowerpot.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) playfully
The adverb "playfully" correctly modifies the participle verb phrase "poking their heads".

questions.text: Please have ________ more rice, you haven't taken much.
questions.textHindi: Please have ________ more rice, you haven't taken much.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) some
"Some" is used in polite offers and requests with uncountable nouns like "rice".

questions.text: Work ________ to score good marks.
questions.textHindi: Work ________ to score good marks.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) hard
"Hard" acts as an adverb meaning with great energy and diligence; "hardly" means almost not at all.

questions.text: Someone was knocking ________ the door.
questions.textHindi: Someone was knocking ________ the door.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) at
The standard preposition used with the verb "knock" referring to a portal is "at".

questions.text: You need to buy ________ refrigerator.
questions.textHindi: You need to buy ________ refrigerator.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) a
"Refrigerator" begins with a consonant sound and is a singular, non-specific countable noun, needing the article "a".

questions.text: We saw a ________ of lions at the sanctuary.
questions.textHindi: We saw a ________ of lions at the sanctuary.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) pride
"Pride" is the correct collective noun for a group of lions.

questions.text: Choose the odd one out:
questions.textHindi: Choose the odd one out:
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Mustard
Mustard is an oilseed/cash crop, whereas wheat, paddy, and barley are cereal grains.

questions.text: I like the books ________ have interesting stories.
questions.textHindi: I like the books ________ have interesting stories.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) that
The relative pronoun "that" is used for non-human things/objects like "books".

questions.text: I have no ________ to you going for a movie.
questions.textHindi: I have no ________ to you going for a movie.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) objection
The sentence requires the noun form "objection" following "no".

questions.text: You ________ cross the road when the traffic light is re
questions.textHindi: You ________ cross the road when the traffic light is re
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) musn't
Traffic laws mandate strict prohibition, which is expressed by "mustn't" (spelled musn't in text).

questions.text: ________ was more important than any other invention.
questions.textHindi: ________ was more important than any other invention.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Agriculture
In Bertrand Russell's "Ideas That Have Helped Mankind", the invention of agriculture is discussed as a profoundly revolutionary step.

questions.text: ________ was Nanukaka's favourite dress.
questions.textHindi: ________ was Nanukaka's favourite dress.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Jodhpuri Coat
In Manohar Malgonkar's "A Pinch of Snuff", Nanukaka wears a knee-length black Jodhpuri coat.

questions.text: ________ was influenced by Mahatma Gandhi.
questions.textHindi: ________ was influenced by Mahatma Gandhi.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) Martin Luther King, Jr.
Martin Luther King, Jr. adopted his philosophy of non-violent resistance directly from Mahatma Gandhi.

questions.text: Every newspaper lives in a precarious ________
questions.textHindi: Every newspaper lives in a precarious ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) balance
In Dorothy L. Sayers' "How Free is the Press", she explains that every newspaper exists in a precarious balance between circulation and advertisers.

questions.text: "But believe that I shall make speedier journeys" is taken from ________
questions.textHindi: "But believe that I shall make speedier journeys" is taken from ________

options.text: Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe
options.textHindi: Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe

questions.correctAnswerText: (D) Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe
These lines are from John Donne's metaphysical love poem "Sweetest Love I Do Not Goe".

questions.text: Lomov is a man conscious of ________
questions.textHindi: Lomov is a man conscious of ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) social class
In Anton Chekhov's play "The Proposal", Lomov is intensely aware of property, wealth, and aristocratic social status.

questions.text: The ________ has become dumb to see the leafless trees.
questions.textHindi: The ________ has become dumb to see the leafless trees.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) nightingale
In W. H. Auden's poem "Now the Leaves Are Falling Fast", the line states: "And the nightingale is dumb".

questions.text: The press enjoys the ________ of the publi
questions.textHindi: The press enjoys the ________ of the publi
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) helplessness
Dorothy L. Sayers notes in "How Free is the Press" that the press often trades upon and exploits the helplessness of the public.

questions.text: Nanukaka has a unique quality of telling ________
questions.textHindi: Nanukaka has a unique quality of telling ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) lies
Nanukaka fabricates extraordinary, elaborate lies to secure meetings with ministers in "A Pinch of Snuff".

questions.text: ________ discrimination was disapproved by Martin Luther King, Jr.
questions.textHindi: ________ discrimination was disapproved by Martin Luther King, Jr.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Racial
Martin Luther King, Jr. campaigned against racial segregation and discrimination targeting Black Americans.

questions.text: Natalia and ________ are quarrelling for the Ox-Meadows.
questions.textHindi: Natalia and ________ are quarrelling for the Ox-Meadows.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) Lomov
In Anton Chekhov's "The Proposal", Natalia and Lomov erupt into a dispute claiming ownership of the Ox-Meadows.

questions.text: English is a ________
questions.textHindi: English is a ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) window to the world
English is celebrated as a "window to the world" because it facilitates global communication, science, and literature.

questions.text: The Norman Conquest made England into little more than a colony of ________
questions.textHindi: The Norman Conquest made England into little more than a colony of ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) France
Following 1066, Norman rulers introduced French language and governance, turning England into a French-dominated domain.

questions.text: Langland is a well known writer of ________ English literature.
questions.textHindi: Langland is a well known writer of ________ English literature.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Middle
William Langland (author of Piers Plowman) is a celebrated Middle English poet alongside Chaucer.

questions.text: The Anglo-Saxons invaded England in the ________ century.
questions.textHindi: The Anglo-Saxons invaded England in the ________ century.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) fifth
Germanic tribes (Angles, Saxons, and Jutes) invaded Britain in the middle of the 5th century AD (around 449 AD).

questions.text: In the poem Snake, Lawrence denounces the artificialities of ________ life.
questions.textHindi: In the poem Snake, Lawrence denounces the artificialities of ________ life.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) modern
D. H. Lawrence criticizes the educated prejudices and corrupt artificial conditioning of modern civilized life.

questions.text: For all the ills in India, the writer blames ________
questions.textHindi: For all the ills in India, the writer blames ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) the British rule
Pearl S. Buck in "India Through a Traveller's Eyes" places primary blame for poverty and starvation on British imperial exploitation.

questions.text: Benjy owned a ________
questions.textHindi: Benjy owned a ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) Ford Van
In H. E. Bates' short story "The Earth", Benjy buys a second-hand Ford van to transport eggs to the market.

questions.text: Seibei's parents knew that Seibei often went out to buy ________
questions.textHindi: Seibei's parents knew that Seibei often went out to buy ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (B) gourds
In Shiga Naoya's "The Artist", Seibei is obsessed with searching for and polishing gourds.

questions.text: Advertisers contribute to the ________ of the newspaper.
questions.textHindi: Advertisers contribute to the ________ of the newspaper.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) revenue
Advertisements are the primary financial lifeline providing the indispensable revenue for commercial newspapers.

questions.text: What figure of speech has been used in "My Grandmother's House" ?
questions.textHindi: What figure of speech has been used in "My Grandmother's House" ?
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) Simile
Kamala Das writes lines such as "my blood turned cold like the moon", utilizing explicit similes.

questions.text: ________ is the prime instrument of nation building.
questions.textHindi: ________ is the prime instrument of nation building.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (A) Education
In his speech "Bharat is My Home", Dr. Zakir Husain asserts that education is the prime instrument of national purpose and development.

questions.text: "I Have a Dream" is part of a ________
questions.textHindi: "I Have a Dream" is part of a ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (D) speech
"I Have a Dream" is the iconic public address delivered by Martin Luther King, Jr. in Washington D.C. in 1963.

questions.text: "We saw embers losing their cruel redness" is taken from ________
questions.textHindi: "We saw embers losing their cruel redness" is taken from ________
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) Fire-Hymn
This imagery of burning coals is drawn from Keki N. Daruwalla's poem "Fire-Hymn".

questions.text: The poet is ________ the snake.
questions.textHindi: The poet is ________ the snake.
questions.explanationHindi:
Correct Answer: (C) afraid of

questions.modelAnswer:
wer:
Impact of Media on Lifestyle:
The media exerts a tremendous influence on our lifestyle, habits, and viewpoints in the 21st century. Through newspapers, television, smartphones, and social media platforms, information circulates around the globe instantly. On the positive side, modern media enhances global awareness, democratizes knowledge, and provides educational resources at the touch of a screen. It keeps citizens abreast of civic affairs, health, and science. However, its unchecked expansion brings noticeable drawbacks. Digital platforms frequently propagate unrealistic body standards, toxic consumer trends, and sensationalized news, fostering anxiety among youth. Sedentary habits associated with excessive screen time have sparked lifestyle ailments such as obesity and insomnia. Moreover, the algorithmic amplification of clickbait often reduces deep concentration and fuels polarization. To harvest the advantages of media without succumbing to its pitfalls, individuals must cultivate critical discernment, engage in digital detoxes, and consume online content with mindful moderation.
